cases.how_to: Settings - Design Settings, then in the Design Settings tab scroll to Search Results Pages, expand it and enable the Google Map Search Results add-on so Member Search Results display in Map View. Requires the Google Maps API to be set up (see Guide 9) and the add-on is included with the VIP Add-Ons Club or purchasable individually.
Place the top and sub-category fields on one member form, as described in the knowledge base article 'How To Place Top & Sub Categories on One Member Form'.
Install the Easy Coupon Codes add-on; the Edit Checkout Pages feature is used to add the coupon input field to the signup or checkout form if it is not already shown.
Install the Tax and VAT Manager add-on and create tax/VAT rules for European locations in it, so they apply at checkout.

Set the Website Status to "Staging Mode" to show the coming soon splash page; switch back to Live Mode at launch. See "How To Activate 'Staging Mode' / 'Coming Soon' Splash Page as the Homepage" and "Coming Soon Page - Dashboard Installer" in the support articles.
Member Profile Badges add-on, tied to premium membership levels (Finance » Membership Plans - Profile Page)
Members >> Import Members >> Import CSV File

Follow the 'How to Login As Member' article in the help center (https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000036189-how-to-login-as-member), which uses the default /login page with the member's email and password.

Follow the help center article 'Workaround: Members Selecting Multiple Top Level Categories': create one general top-level category that captures all members, then place the other categories beneath it as sub and sub-subcategories so members can select multiple sub-categories.
Use the 301 Redirects feature in the Brilliant Directories admin (see the 301 Redirects support article).
Set "Require All Reviews To be Approved by Admin First" to YES (found in Finance » Membership Plans - Profile Page), then approve reviews under Interactions → Member Reviews.
Settings » General Settings » Integrations Tab: paste your GA4 Measurement ID there (see 'Installing Google Analytics Tracking Code (easy method)').
Enhancing Security with Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) and Account Dashboard » Login Settings

Get the Google Website Translator add-on (included with the VIP Add-Ons Club or purchasable individually), then optionally limit languages under Settings » Advanced Settings by editing translate_languages.

Admin Dashboard > Developer Hub >> Webhooks: set up the webhook for "Contact Us Form Submitted", paste the Custom Webhook URL copied from Zapier's "Catch Hook" trigger, and click "Save Webhook Settings". Then test with a filled-in form submission and click "Test Trigger" in Zapier.

Set the membership plan to a Yearly Price (billed every 12 months, recurring) under Finance » Membership Plans - Sign Ups & Upgrades, and connect Stripe as the payment gateway as described in Guide 7. How to Connect Payment Gateway to Process Payments.
Follow the help article 'How to Turn The Brilliant Directories Directory Website into a Mobile Application for Apple & Android'.
Design Settings » Select Content to Display (Stream Content On The Homepage); Adding Custom Content to the Homepage Hero Section; How to Add Custom Content to the Homepage
Optimizing Website Performance; Developer Hub » Image Settings; Front-End Optimization: Lazyload iFrame Embeds; Upload Files With A Unique Name To Leverage Browser Caching
Use the Google Map Search Results add-on, which displays front-end search results (members, posts and more) on an interactive Google Map instead of the default list layout.

Follow the knowledge base article "How To Place Top & Sub Categories on One Member Form" to put both the top category and sub-category fields on one member form, which members then use from the Member Dashboard.
Use the Easy Coupon Codes add-on to create the discount codes. Members enter the code in the Promo Code field at checkout, or you can add the code to the signup URL so it is applied automatically.
Use the Tax and VAT Manager add-on to create location-specific tax/VAT rules for checkout covering the European countries you need; these apply to one-time and recurring membership payments.

Settings >> General Settings, "General" section: set the Website Status dropdown to "Staging Mode". Edit the page with the "EDIT COMING SOON PAGE" link, and on launch day set Website Status back to Live Mode.
Use the plan-based badges add-on described in the 'Member Profile Badges' help article, together with the Verified status, which shows a badge in search results.

Go to Members >> Import Members >> Import CSV File. Prepare the CSV with a company or name (or first_name and last_name, but not both) for every listing, enter Company or Individual in listing_type, and put the Top Level category in profession_name exactly as it appears in the directory (optional comma-separated Sub Level Categories go in services). Create the category structure on the site first, use valid URLs (https://...), and save the file as UTF-8 via Google Sheets if it has special characters. For claimable listings, select the membership plan "My Claim Listings" during import.
Use the /login page method described in the help article "How to Login As Member": an admin enters the member's email and password.

Follow the documented workaround "Members Selecting Multiple Top Level Categories": create one general Top-level category that captures all members, and make the remaining categories sub and sub-subcategories so members can select multiple sub-categories.
Use the built-in 301 Redirect Rules feature to map each old page address to its new address (see the '301 Redirects' support article).
Turn on the review setting "Require All Reviews To be Approved by Admin First" (set to YES). Approve pending reviews from the admin, as described in "Approving Member Reviews from the Admin".

Settings » General Settings » Integrations tab: paste your GA4 Measurement ID (format G-XXXXXXX) into the Google Analytics 4 field. Copy the ID from Google Analytics under Admin by searching for "Measurement ID".

Use the built-in two-factor authentication (2FA) feature for admin logins (email one-time code), as described in 'Enhancing Security with Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)' and 'Account Dashboard » Login Settings'.

Install and enable the Google Website Translator add-on to show the language drop-down on the site. To make Spanish the default, use Settings » General Settings » Localization (see 'How To Edit/Change Default Language of Websites').
Use Webhooks in the Developer Hub to create a webhook for Contact Us form submissions, and point it at a Zapier Catch Hook trigger.

Enable the Yearly Price on the membership plan under Finance » Membership Plans - Sign Ups & Upgrades, and connect Stripe as the payment gateway (see Guide 7. How to Connect Payment Gateway to Process Payments; Stripe is listed under Supported Payment Gateways).

Turn the directory website into a WebView-based mobile app for Apple and Android using a third-party tool such as Appy Pie, as described in 'How to Turn The Brilliant Directories Directory Website into a Mobile Application for Apple & Android'.
